atoms.text: Dimitri is a singer. Tonight, he is supposed to be playing a concert with his friends. When he woke up this morning, he realised that he had lost his voice and would be unable to sing. He also has a fever and feels very unwell.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, what is the most likely outcome?
b: Dimitri is fine and will perform with the band.
++The band will reschedule the concert to give Dimitri time to get better.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: The band’s guitarist, Jason, calls the music venue to let them know that they will not be able to make the concert. The phone rings but nobody answers it. Jason immediately gets dressed and goes to get his front door keys.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, what is Jason going to do?
b: ++Jason is going to go and tell the owner of the venue that they cannot attend the concert.
Jason is going to do some shopping.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the question.

atoms.text: Jason arrives at the music venue. The venue is completely empty. Jason looks around for the owner, but he cannot find her. He goes to the sofa area and sits down.

atoms.a: Based on what you have read, what is Jason going to do?
b: ++Jason is going to wait for the owner.
Jason is going to give up and go home.
